_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Misadventure on the Sea#000.src: As you touch the obelisk, it ignites with an otherworldly blue light...
Misadventure on the Sea#000.dst: Dikilitaşa dokunduğunda öteki dünyadan gelme mavi bir ışıkla parlıyor...

Misadventure on the Sea#001.src: So... I've seen ya around town. You've got the soul of an adventurer, don't ya?
Misadventure on the Sea#001.dst: Eee... Seni kasabada görüyorum. Sende bir maceracı ruhu var, değil mi?

Misadventure on the Sea#003.src: Don't think we'll be done with ya once you clean all of this!
Misadventure on the Sea#003.dst: Bunların hepsini temizledin diye seninle işimiz bitti sanma!

Misadventure on the Sea#005.src: Sitting on this stool will start Misadventure on the Sea.
Misadventure on the Sea#005.dst: Bu tabureye oturursan Denizde Talihsizlik başlar.

Misadventure on the Sea#006.src: I'll take two {p} Whiskeys. One for me, one for this chap.
Misadventure on the Sea#006.dst: İki {p} Viskisi alayım. Biri bana, biri de bu delikanlıya.
Misadventure on the Sea#006.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#008.src: I'll wait for ya at the docks. Don't worry, ya can't miss the boat!
Misadventure on the Sea#008.dst: Seni rıhtımda beklerim. Merak etme, tekneyi gözden kaçıramazsın!
Misadventure on the Sea#008.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#009.src: They're a bit too head on, don't you think?
Misadventure on the Sea#009.dst: Biraz fazla dalıyorlar üstümüze, değil mi?
Misadventure on the Sea#009.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#010.src: I'm tryin' to steer the ship but it's not budging...
Misadventure on the Sea#010.dst: Gemiyi çevirmeye çalışıyorum ama kılını kıpırdatmıyor...
Misadventure on the Sea#010.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#011.src: Sounds like you're being dragged around...

Misadventure on the Sea#012.src: You pick up a small sign...

Misadventure on the Sea#014.src: So, there's quite a few bodies in there, and we never bothered throwin' em out!
Misadventure on the Sea#014.dst: Şimdi, orada epey ceset var ve hiç dışarı atmaya üşendik!
Misadventure on the Sea#014.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#015.src: Go ahead, here's a sponge for the dried blood as well. Just wack the bodies with it!
Misadventure on the Sea#015.dst: Hadi bakalım, al şu süngeri de kurumuş kan için. Cesetlere bununla vur yeter!
Misadventure on the Sea#015.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#017.src: You take a look inside the furnaces...

Misadventure on the Sea#019.src: An absurd amount of wood shavings, for some reason.

Misadventure on the Sea#020.src: Looks like the door that leads to the hold...

Misadventure on the Sea#021.src: It's locked. Probably because of the rat issue. Honip must have the key.
Misadventure on the Sea#021.dst: Kilitli. Muhtemelen fare sorunu yüzünden. Anahtar Honip'te olmalı.

Misadventure on the Sea#022.src: You find some notes on the table.

Misadventure on the Sea#023.src: There's mentions of... A human cannon? How does that make sense?
Misadventure on the Sea#023.dst: Bir... insan topundan bahsediliyor? Bu nasıl mantıklı olabilir ki?

Misadventure on the Sea#024.src: Apparently, only gunpowder is needed, as well as a fuse.
Misadventure on the Sea#024.dst: Anlaşılan sadece barut ve bir fitil gerekiyor.

Misadventure on the Sea#025.src: This cannon is aiming slightly upwards, and it seems less powerful than the others.
Misadventure on the Sea#025.dst: Bu top hafifçe yukarı nişan alıyor ve diğerlerinden daha zayıf görünüyor.

Misadventure on the Sea#026.src: According to the notes you saw, it's probably the "human" cannon. This must be your escape route!
Misadventure on the Sea#026.dst: Gördüğün notlara bakılırsa, bu muhtemelen "insan" topu. Kaçış yolun bu olmalı!

Misadventure on the Sea#028.src: There are mentions of a hidden key in the hold...

Misadventure on the Sea#029.src: You should probably search the hold later, when possible.

Misadventure on the Sea#030.src: You cleaned the bodies! You should talk to Honip on the deck.
Misadventure on the Sea#030.dst: Cesetleri temizledin! Güvertede Honip ile konuşmalısın.

Misadventure on the Sea#031.src: 'ey! How's the cleaning? Don't forget to check everywhere, ya never know what you might find!
Misadventure on the Sea#031.dst: Hey! Temizlik nasıl gidiyo'? Her yere bakmayı unutma, ne bulacağın belli olmaz!

Misadventure on the Sea#032.src: You're done? Well good job! Honip's next to the helm if you're lookin' for him.
Misadventure on the Sea#032.dst: Bitti mi? Aferin sana! Honip'i arıyorsan dümenin yanında.

Misadventure on the Sea#033.src: You've been running around the boat for a while now!

Misadventure on the Sea#035.src: Honip's probably waitin' for ya by now! Take these ladders next to me, he's up there.
Misadventure on the Sea#035.dst: Honip şimdiye seni bekliyordur! Yanımdaki merdivenlerden çık, yukarıda.

Misadventure on the Sea#036.src: If you lose your sponge, Honip can give you a new one on the deck.
Misadventure on the Sea#036.dst: Süngerini kaybedersen Honip güvertede sana yenisini verebilir.

Misadventure on the Sea#037.src: The only boat that will take ye directly to {p}.
Misadventure on the Sea#037.dst: Seni doğrudan {p} limanına götürecek tek tekne.

Misadventure on the Sea#038.src: Hey! You aren't allowed on my ship!

Misadventure on the Sea#039.src: This hologram will teleport you back on the island to continue the quest or Reset your quest.
Misadventure on the Sea#039.dst: Bu hologram, göreve devam etmen için seni adaya geri ışınlar ya da görevini Sıfırlar.

Misadventure on the Sea#040.src: Are you sure you wish to Reset your quest?

Misadventure on the Sea#041.src: Misadventure On The Sea has been reset!

Misadventure on the Sea#042.src: Maybe you could somehow use it..? There's no way to tell how dangerous it is. Probably very.
Misadventure on the Sea#042.dst: Belki bunu bir şekilde kullanabilirsin..? Ne kadar tehlikeli olduğunu bilmenin yolu yok. Muhtemelen çok.

Misadventure on the Sea#043.src: It must be the one up you saw up there! That's got to be the way to escape!
Misadventure on the Sea#043.dst: Yukarıda gördüğün o olmalı! Kaçış yolu kesin bu!

Misadventure on the Sea#044.src: Who knows, maybe there's gunpowder in there?
Misadventure on the Sea#044.dst: Kim bilir, belki içinde barut vardır?

Misadventure on the Sea#045.src: Seems like it likes you now!

Misadventure on the Sea#046.src: Not done yet? Well, take your time!
Misadventure on the Sea#046.dst: Daha bitmedi mi? Eh, acele etme!

Misadventure on the Sea#047.src: We sometimes hear unusually loud footsteps, along with some really eerie squeaking...
Misadventure on the Sea#047.dst: Bazen alışılmadık derecede gürültülü ayak sesleri duyuyoruz, bir de çok ürkütücü cıyaklamalar...
Misadventure on the Sea#047.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#048.src: Looks like this crate is filled with rat hair, with some eaten carrots.
Misadventure on the Sea#048.dst: Bu sandık fare tüyüyle dolu, bir de birkaç yenmiş havuç var.

Misadventure on the Sea#049.src: You defeated the rats! You should grab the gunpowder and the fuse before leaving.
Misadventure on the Sea#049.dst: Fareleri yendin! Gitmeden önce barutu ve fitili almalısın.

Misadventure on the Sea#053.src: Looks like this crate is filled with even more rat hair!
Misadventure on the Sea#053.dst: Bu sandık daha da fazla fare tüyüyle dolu!

Misadventure on the Sea#054.src: You picked up a dusty key!

Misadventure on the Sea#056.src: You got the fuse as well as the gunpowder. Looks like you can use that cannon now!
Misadventure on the Sea#056.dst: Hem fitili hem barutu aldın. Artık o topu kullanabilirsin!

Misadventure on the Sea#057.src: You put the gunpowder in the cannon and attach the fuse...

Misadventure on the Sea#058.src: Looks like it's fully functional. Make sure the pirates don't see you! Once you leave, you won't be able to come back.
Misadventure on the Sea#058.dst: Tamamen çalışır durumda görünüyor. Korsanların seni görmediğinden emin ol! Bir kez gittin mi geri dönemezsin.

Misadventure on the Sea#064.src: Huh? Something's approaching off in the distance...

Misadventure on the Sea#065.src: Looks like they're headed toward the island! Is that..?
Misadventure on the Sea#065.dst: Adaya doğru geliyorlar gibi! Yoksa bu..?

Misadventure on the Sea#066.src: Ah... Trust. Say, why don't I make it so you can travel to {p} for free? That way, if ya ever think o' doin' somethin' foolish like that again, ya can jus' take a trip on my ol' ship!
Misadventure on the Sea#066.dst: Ah... Güven. Bak ne diyeceğim, seni {p} limanına bedavaya götüreyim, ne dersin? Böylece bir daha öyle aptalca bi'şey yapmayı aklından geçirirsen benim emektar gemimle yolculuk edersin!

Misadventure on the Sea#068.src: Hello there soldier! What can I get you?
Misadventure on the Sea#068.speaker: Barman

Misadventure on the Sea#070.src: So... I've seen ya around town. I saw how happy that guy was when you brought him some journal.
Misadventure on the Sea#070.dst: Eee... Seni kasabada görüyorum. Şu adama bir defter getirdiğinde nasıl sevindiğini gördüm.
Misadventure on the Sea#070.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#072.src: So... Soldier. Are ya up for sailin' the ocean with me? I got a fancier boat than that seaskipper!
Misadventure on the Sea#072.dst: Eee... Asker. Benimle okyanusa açılmaya var mısın? O Seaskipper'dan çok daha havalı bir teknem var!
Misadventure on the Sea#072.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#073.src: I figured you'd be interested in explorin' the waters!
Misadventure on the Sea#073.dst: Suları keşfetmek ilgini çeker diye düşündüm!
Misadventure on the Sea#073.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#075.src: There you are! Ready? Follow me, the boat's over here!
Misadventure on the Sea#075.dst: İşte buradasın! Hazır mısın? Beni takip et, tekne şurada!
Misadventure on the Sea#075.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#076.src: Look at this.. Magnificent! Much better than whatever the Seaskipper is using!
Misadventure on the Sea#076.dst: Şuna bak.. Muhteşem! Seaskipper ne kullanıyorsa ondan çok daha iyi!
Misadventure on the Sea#076.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#077.src: Well, what are you waiting for? Hop aboard!
Misadventure on the Sea#077.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#078.src: Then it's settled, we're goin' on an adventure!
Misadventure on the Sea#078.dst: O zaman karar verildi, maceraya çıkıyoruz!
Misadventure on the Sea#078.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#079.src: Buckle up, we got waves to catch.
Misadventure on the Sea#079.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#080.src: So... I should warn ya', this is actually my first time sailing...
Misadventure on the Sea#080.dst: Eee... Seni uyarayım, aslında bu benim ilk denize açılışım...
Misadventure on the Sea#080.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#081.src: It doesn't seem too difficult though, a little to the left...
Misadventure on the Sea#081.dst: Yine de çok zor görünmüyor, biraz sola...
Misadventure on the Sea#081.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#082.src: Hmm, looks like we're not the only ones out on the water today.
Misadventure on the Sea#082.dst: Hmm, bugün denizde olan tek biz değilmişiz.
Misadventure on the Sea#082.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#086.src: I honestly, truly can't believe you fell for that. Let me sum it up for you...
Misadventure on the Sea#086.dst: Bu tuzağa düştüğüne gerçekten, cidden inanamıyorum. Sana bir özetleyeyim...
Misadventure on the Sea#086.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#087.src: Some extremely suspicious pirate comes up, offers you a drink, and leads you to his suspicious boat.
Misadventure on the Sea#087.dst: Son derece şüpheli bir korsan yanına geliyor, sana içki ısmarlıyor ve seni şüpheli teknesine götürüyor.
Misadventure on the Sea#087.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#088.src: Any normal person would've turned back by then. But what do you do? You hop on! Well, now you're stuck with us.
Misadventure on the Sea#088.dst: Normal biri o noktada geri dönerdi. Ama sen ne yapıyorsun? Atlıyorsun! Eh, artık bizimle kaldın.
Misadventure on the Sea#088.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#089.src: Let me make this quick. This boat needs renovation, and we want you to do it.
Misadventure on the Sea#089.dst: Kısa keseyim. Bu teknenin elden geçmesi lazım ve bunu senin yapmanı istiyoruz.
Misadventure on the Sea#089.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#090.src: Why? You're a soldier! All you do is take orders! Anyway, we'll need you to clean our stuff. Here, get out.
Misadventure on the Sea#090.dst: Neden mi? Sen askersin! Tek yaptığın emir almak! Neyse, eşyalarımızı temizlemen gerekecek. Hadi, çık dışarı.
Misadventure on the Sea#090.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#092.src: I told you to stay back!
Misadventure on the Sea#092.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#094.src: If you need me, I'll be on the deck. And, uh, don't go in the hold. We've got a BIG rat problem.
Misadventure on the Sea#094.dst: Bana ihtiyacın olursa güvertedeyim. Bir de, ee, ambara girme. KOCA bir fare sorunumuz var.
Misadventure on the Sea#094.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#095.src: Also, for the sake of my crew, could you be more cooperative? I don't have an unlimited amount of these potions.
Misadventure on the Sea#095.dst: Bir de tayfamın hatırı için biraz daha uysal olur musun? Bu iksirlerden sınırsız yok bende.
Misadventure on the Sea#095.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#096.src: Clean the bodies in the boat. Look for clues on how to escape at the same time. -Bodies cleaned: #/{~}
Misadventure on the Sea#096.dst: Teknedeki cesetleri temizle. Bu sırada kaçış için ipucu ara. -Temizlenen ceset: #/{~}

Misadventure on the Sea#097.src: Hey, so you're our personal guard, huh?
Misadventure on the Sea#097.dst: Hey, demek bizim özel muhafızımız sensin, ha?
Misadventure on the Sea#097.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#099.src: That ladder leads to the hold, but right now it's locked... We've got a severe case of rats.
Misadventure on the Sea#099.dst: O merdiven ambara iner ama şu an kilitli... Ciddi bir fare sorunumuz var.
Misadventure on the Sea#099.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#100.src: Pep is just a treasure, ain't I right? I'm glad you're taking care of him too!
Misadventure on the Sea#100.dst: Pep tam bir hazine, değil mi ama? Ona da baktığına sevindim!
Misadventure on the Sea#100.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#101.src: Honip has a pet chicken, weird right?
Misadventure on the Sea#101.dst: Honip'in evcil bir tavuğu var, tuhaf değil mi?
Misadventure on the Sea#101.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#102.src: I bet he got inspiration from that weird guy on his island...
Misadventure on the Sea#102.dst: Bahse girerim fikri adasındaki şu tuhaf adamdan almıştır...
Misadventure on the Sea#102.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#103.src: What? You murdered that guy's most prized chicken? You're an odd one, soldier.
Misadventure on the Sea#103.dst: Ne? O adamın en kıymetli tavuğunu mu öldürdün? Tuhaf birisin sen, asker.
Misadventure on the Sea#103.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#104.src: Oh, uh... Don't worry about that, 'ay?
Misadventure on the Sea#104.dst: Ah, ee... Sen onu kafana takma, olur mu?
Misadventure on the Sea#104.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#106.src: Oh, that's my cannon! Pretty cool, right? I made it using a bunch of arm- Nevermind...
Misadventure on the Sea#106.dst: Ah, o benim topum! Havalı, değil mi? Bir sürü kol kullanarak yap- Boş ver...
Misadventure on the Sea#106.speaker: Seth

Misadventure on the Sea#108.src: He's a strong chicken alright, trust me on that one.
Misadventure on the Sea#108.dst: Güçlü tavuktur o, bu konuda bana güven.
Misadventure on the Sea#108.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#110.src: I'm just goin' to... Wait here... With my cannons...
Misadventure on the Sea#110.speaker: Seth

Misadventure on the Sea#111.src: Talk to Honip on the deck to get your next task
Misadventure on the Sea#111.dst: Sıradaki görevini almak için güvertede Honip ile konuş

Misadventure on the Sea#112.src: Hey! The boat's lookin' real nice now!
Misadventure on the Sea#112.dst: Hey! Tekne artık bayağı güzel görünüyor!
Misadventure on the Sea#112.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#113.src: I'll probably let you rest so- hold on.
Misadventure on the Sea#113.dst: Galiba seni biraz dinlendireceğim, o yüzden- dur bir saniye.
Misadventure on the Sea#113.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#114.src: Ho-Honip! One of the guys said he saw something really weird coming right for us!
Misadventure on the Sea#114.dst: Ho-Honip! Adamlardan biri çok tuhaf bir şeyin doğruca bize geldiğini gördüğünü söyledi!
Misadventure on the Sea#114.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#117.src: We-we don't know! We can't exactly see it, but it seems huge!
Misadventure on the Sea#117.dst: Bi-bilmiyoruz! Tam göremiyoruz ama devasa bir şeye benziyor!
Misadventure on the Sea#117.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#119.src: Uh... Where am I supposed to be looking at, exactly?
Misadventure on the Sea#119.dst: Ee... Tam olarak nereye bakmam gerekiyor?
Misadventure on the Sea#119.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#120.src: I swear, it felt like the whole ocean was getting crazy a second ago!
Misadventure on the Sea#120.dst: Yemin ederim, bir saniye önce bütün okyanus deliye dönmüş gibiydi!
Misadventure on the Sea#120.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#121.src: If this is another one of your jokes...
Misadventure on the Sea#121.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#124.src: I don't know, this wasn't planned!
Misadventure on the Sea#124.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#125.src: Soldier, now's your time to shine! Scare it off with one of your spells or something!
Misadventure on the Sea#125.dst: Asker, parlama sırası sende! Büyülerinden biriyle falan korkut şunu!
Misadventure on the Sea#125.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#130.src: I knew you had it in ya, haha!
Misadventure on the Sea#130.dst: Sende o cevherin olduğunu biliyordum, haha!
Misadventure on the Sea#130.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#131.src: What a show! Come, I've got some things to tell ya!
Misadventure on the Sea#131.dst: Ne gösteriydi ama! Gel, sana anlatacaklarım var!
Misadventure on the Sea#131.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#132.src: I don't know where that creature came from, but thanks to you it's gone.
Misadventure on the Sea#132.dst: O yaratık nereden geldi bilmiyorum ama senin sayende gitti.
Misadventure on the Sea#132.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#133.src: I've got somethin' else for you to tackle. It's about... the rats.
Misadventure on the Sea#133.dst: Halletmen gereken başka bir işim var. Şeyle ilgili... fareler.
Misadventure on the Sea#133.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#134.src: Come to the hold, I'll explain on the way.
Misadventure on the Sea#134.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#135.src: I think we have quite a hellish problem on our hands.
Misadventure on the Sea#135.dst: Sanırım başımızda cehennem gibi bir dert var.
Misadventure on the Sea#135.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#136.src: I'm not sure what ya'll find there, but these are NOT normal rats.
Misadventure on the Sea#136.dst: Orada ne bulursun bilmiyorum ama bunlar normal fareler DEĞİL.
Misadventure on the Sea#136.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#137.src: Have you heard of "the bird island"?
Misadventure on the Sea#137.speaker:
Neny
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Misadventure on the Sea#138.src: Some people wearing goggles have been going around calling it the fourth province.
Misadventure on the Sea#138.dst: Gözlük takan bazı tipler ortalıkta dolaşıp oraya dördüncü eyalet diyor.
Misadventure on the Sea#138.speaker:
Neny
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Misadventure on the Sea#139.src: Maybe if people see it they will become more internationally recognised.
Misadventure on the Sea#139.dst: Belki insanlar orayı görürse uluslararası alanda daha çok tanınırlar.
Misadventure on the Sea#139.speaker:
Neny
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Misadventure on the Sea#140.src: So please, get in there... and kill everything, alright?
Misadventure on the Sea#140.dst: O yüzden lütfen, gir oraya... ve her şeyi öldür, tamam mı?
Misadventure on the Sea#140.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#141.src: I've got faith in ya. Here goes nothin'!
Misadventure on the Sea#141.dst: Sana güveniyorum. Hadi bakalım, ya nasip!
Misadventure on the Sea#141.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#142.src: Just cast one of your fancy spells!
Misadventure on the Sea#142.dst: Şu havalı büyülerinden birini yap yeter!
Misadventure on the Sea#142.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#143.src: That was... Phew... That was something.
Misadventure on the Sea#143.dst: Bu... Of... Bu bayağı bir şeydi.
Misadventure on the Sea#143.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#144.src: Now, for an even bigger surprise...
Misadventure on the Sea#144.dst: Şimdi de daha büyük bir sürprize...
Misadventure on the Sea#144.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#145.src: What the hell, soldier?? What don't you get in the "soldier" part of your job?
Misadventure on the Sea#145.dst: Ne halt ediyorsun, asker?? İşinin "asker" kısmının neresini anlamıyorsun?
Misadventure on the Sea#145.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#146.src: Come, let's figure some things out.
Misadventure on the Sea#146.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#147.src: You've been a massive disappointment, y'know?
Misadventure on the Sea#147.dst: Tam bir hayal kırıklığısın, biliyor musun?
Misadventure on the Sea#147.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#148.src: But you can still redeem yourself.
Misadventure on the Sea#148.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#149.src: Follow me, I'll explain on the way.
Misadventure on the Sea#149.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#150.src: I mentioned a rat problem earlier... It's, uh, not a small one.
Misadventure on the Sea#150.dst: Daha önce bir fare sorunundan bahsetmiştim... Şey, ufak bir sorun değil.
Misadventure on the Sea#150.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#151.src: We've got gunpowder to retrieve, so you're the one who's gonna clear the hold.
Misadventure on the Sea#151.dst: Alınacak barutumuz var, o yüzden ambarı temizleyecek kişi sensin.
Misadventure on the Sea#151.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#152.src: So get in there... and try to kill everything, alright?
Misadventure on the Sea#152.dst: O yüzden gir oraya... ve her şeyi öldürmeye çalış, tamam mı?
Misadventure on the Sea#152.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#153.src: Don't be as bad as earlier. You're a soldier.
Misadventure on the Sea#153.dst: Az önceki kadar kötü olma. Sen askersin.
Misadventure on the Sea#153.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#156.src: I expected you to do somethin', soldier, not him!
Misadventure on the Sea#156.dst: Bir şey yapmanı bekliyordum asker, onun değil!
Misadventure on the Sea#156.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#158.src: I have another task for you. It's about... the rats.
Misadventure on the Sea#158.dst: Sana başka bir işim var. Şeyle ilgili... fareler.
Misadventure on the Sea#158.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#159.src: See, I really don't think we have your usual type of problem.
Misadventure on the Sea#159.dst: Bak, bizimki pek alışıldık türden bir sorun değil bence.
Misadventure on the Sea#159.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#160.src: That's why we're not too fond of goin' in... But our gunpowder there! We need it, as pirates!
Misadventure on the Sea#160.dst: O yüzden içeri girmeye pek hevesli değiliz... Ama barutumuz orada! Korsan olarak ona ihtiyacımız var!
Misadventure on the Sea#160.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#161.src: So, I need you to get in... and kill everything, alright?
Misadventure on the Sea#161.dst: O yüzden içeri girmeni... ve her şeyi öldürmeni istiyorum, tamam mı?
Misadventure on the Sea#161.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#162.src: Here goes nothing. Snoo, ya stay there!
Misadventure on the Sea#162.dst: Hadi bakalım, ya nasip. Snoo, sen orada kal!
Misadventure on the Sea#162.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#163.src: Explore the hold and kill the rats

Misadventure on the Sea#164.src: Defeat the Colossal Rat in the hold

Misadventure on the Sea#165.src: Use the gunpowder and the fuse to activate the cannon and escape
Misadventure on the Sea#165.dst: Barut ve fitille topu çalıştırıp kaç

Misadventure on the Sea#166.src: Hey there! Ya bringin' me good news?
Misadventure on the Sea#166.dst: Hey selam! Bana iyi haberler mi getiriyorsun?
Misadventure on the Sea#166.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#167.src: You took care of these damn thieving rodents? A... colossal rat you say?
Misadventure on the Sea#167.dst: O lanet olası hırsız kemirgenlerin işini bitirdin mi? Bir... devasa fare mi diyorsun?
Misadventure on the Sea#167.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#168.src: Nicely done, I knew I could count on ya! C'mere, take these!
Misadventure on the Sea#168.dst: Aferin, sana güvenebileceğimi biliyordum! Gel buraya, al şunları!
Misadventure on the Sea#168.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#169.src: Anyway, for now, you can go rest and do whatever you want!
Misadventure on the Sea#169.dst: Neyse, şimdilik gidip dinlenebilir, canın ne isterse yapabilirsin!
Misadventure on the Sea#169.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#170.src: Well, shiver me timbers! You did redeem yourself, soldier!
Misadventure on the Sea#170.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#172.src: Huh? It looks like there's a hidden lock in this bookshelf!
Misadventure on the Sea#172.dst: Ha? Bu kitaplıkta gizli bir kilit var gibi!

Misadventure on the Sea#173.src: Where could the key be? Does the crew know about this?
Misadventure on the Sea#173.dst: Anahtar nerede olabilir? Tayfanın bundan haberi var mı?

Misadventure on the Sea#174.src: It's barely visible, it's probably not going to help on escaping.
Misadventure on the Sea#174.dst: Zar zor görünüyor, kaçmaya pek bir faydası olmaz herhalde.

Misadventure on the Sea#175.src: That's definitely not a place to store gunpowder, nor a fuse.
Misadventure on the Sea#175.dst: Burası kesinlikle barut ya da fitil saklanacak bir yer değil.

Misadventure on the Sea#177.src: Huh? What did you do?? Oh well, whatever...
Misadventure on the Sea#177.dst: Ha? Sen ne yaptın?? Neyse, boş ver...

Misadventure on the Sea#182.src: Mo'in, traveller, have you heard of Corkus? The new province filled with machines!
Misadventure on the Sea#182.dst: Mo'in gezgin, Corkus'u duydun mu? Makinelerle dolu yeni eyalet!

Misadventure on the Sea#183.src: If you were level {~} I'd let you enter Corkus for free. Come back to me then!
Misadventure on the Sea#183.dst: Seviyen {~} olsaydı Corkus'a bedava girmene izin verirdim. O zaman yine gel!

Misadventure on the Sea#184.src: That sounds absolutely terrifying! And ya did that alone! You know what, her', take these.
Misadventure on the Sea#184.dst: Kulağa düpedüz korkunç geliyor! Hem de bunu tek başına yaptın! Biliyor musun, al, bunlar senin.
Misadventure on the Sea#184.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#185.src: Hey! What do you think you're doin'?!
Misadventure on the Sea#185.speaker: Pirate Guard

Misadventure on the Sea#187.src: No, but they did a great job in the hold! Some gunpowder went missing though.
Misadventure on the Sea#187.dst: Hayır ama ambarda harika iş çıkardı! Gerçi biraz barut kayıp.
Misadventure on the Sea#187.speaker: Seth

Misadventure on the Sea#190.src: Find out where you are and a way to flee the island
Misadventure on the Sea#190.dst: Nerede olduğunu ve adadan kaçmanın bir yolunu bul

Misadventure on the Sea#191.src: 'ey there soldier! Looks like ya're in a bit of a pickle! How 'bout ya hop on?'
Misadventure on the Sea#191.dst: Hey asker! Başın biraz dertte gibi! Atlasana?
Misadventure on the Sea#191.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#192.src: Well... We're headed for {p}, the heart of the ocean! Which is safer than wherever you were, heh!
Misadventure on the Sea#192.dst: Eh... Rotamız {p}, okyanusun kalbi! Neresi olursa olsun, bulunduğun yerden daha güvenli, heh!
Misadventure on the Sea#192.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#193.src: I was casually takin' a scenic detour when I saw you and your shiny equipment on that island.
Misadventure on the Sea#193.dst: Öylesine manzaralı bir yoldan geçiyordum ki seni ve parlak teçhizatını o adada gördüm.
Misadventure on the Sea#193.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#194.src: So, ya gotta tell me what happened!
Misadventure on the Sea#194.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#195.src: Oh, kidnapped by pirates I see! How unfortunate...
Misadventure on the Sea#195.dst: Aa, korsanlar tarafından kaçırıldın demek! Ne talihsizlik...
Misadventure on the Sea#195.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#196.src: I guess that'll show ya, tryin' to avoid using good ol' seaskipper! I'm the only trustworthy one 'round here.
Misadventure on the Sea#196.dst: Bu sana ders olur, emektar Seaskipper'ı kullanmamaya çalışırsan böyle olur! Buralarda güvenilir tek kişi benim.
Misadventure on the Sea#196.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#197.src: Well, I hope they weren't too bad with ya! Here, I'll make you travel to {p} for free as compensation.
Misadventure on the Sea#197.dst: Eh, umarım sana çok kötü davranmamışlardır! Al bakalım, telafi olarak seni {p} limanına bedava götüreyim.
Misadventure on the Sea#197.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#198.src: Anyway, I can see the shore off in the distance! Hang tight, we're almost there!
Misadventure on the Sea#198.dst: Neyse, uzakta kıyıyı görebiliyorum! Sıkı tutun, neredeyse vardık!
Misadventure on the Sea#198.speaker: Seaskipper Captain
